source.post_text:
We are watching the collapse of gaming and utter disrespect of players and the craft in real time, and we’re being gaslit to think it isn’t happening or that it’s somehow a good thing🚀

🗣️Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick argues that physical game discs make no sense for consumers

🗣️He also predicts that game streaming will be more commercial/mainstream in about 3 years due to the increasing prices of consoles and PC (Did he forget Stadia???)

So hear me out:

✅PCs and consoles became more expensive due to data centers

…
